Package neqsim.thermo.component

Class ComponentNameResolver

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.component.ComponentNameResolver
public final class ComponentNameResolver extends Object
Resolves a user-supplied component name to the name used in the NeqSim component database.

The same molecule is written differently by different tools. The component database uses an in-house shorthand (224-TM-C5), laboratory reports use systematic names (2,2,4-trimethylpentane) or inverted CAS index names (Cyclopentane, 1-ethyl-2-methyl), and reservoir engineering uses yet another shorthand (nC7). This class maps all of them onto the database name.

Resolution proceeds in four steps, and the first hit wins:

  1. case-insensitive match against a database name;
  2. match against the synonym table;
  3. the same two lookups after converting an inverted CAS index name to prefix form;
  4. otherwise the input is returned unchanged.

Stereochemistry is never discarded. Where the database holds both partners of a cis/trans pair, the ambiguous parent name is deliberately absent from the synonym table so that an under-specified name is passed through rather than silently resolved to one of the two.

The tables target the standard database data/COMP.csv. When the extended database is active, a name known only to it is passed through unchanged.

    • normalize

      public static String normalize(String name)
      Normalise a name to its lookup key.

      Lower-cases, removes whitespace, unifies _ to -, and treats a . between two digits as the locant separator , so that 1.2.3-TM-Benzene and 1,2,3-TM-Benzene agree.

      Parameters:
      name - component name; may be null
      Returns:
      normalised key, empty string when the input is null or blank

    • deinvertCasIndexName

      public static String deinvertCasIndexName(String normalizedName)
      Convert an inverted CAS index name to prefix form.

      cyclopentane,1-ethyl-2-methyl becomes 1-ethyl-2-methylcyclopentane. Input that is not in inverted form is returned unchanged.

      Parameters:
      normalizedName - a name already passed through normalize(String)
      Returns:
      the prefix-form name, or the input unchanged

    • addNormalChainPrefixAliases

      private static void addNormalChainPrefixAliases(Map<String,String> synonyms)
      Add explicit n- variants for aliases proven to target a normal-chain NeqSim name.

      Restricting the expansion to canonical targets such as nC10 and nC5-Benzene prevents arbitrary inputs such as n-water or n-isobutane from becoming valid aliases.

      Parameters:
      synonyms - synonym map under construction
